1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de la persona (principlamente un niño) a quien otra recoge bajo su amparo. “Soy recogío… Él me recogió chiquito.” Meléndez Muñoz.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This term refers to a person (primarily a child) who is taken under someone's care and protection. "I am the one who was picked up... He took me in when I was little."
